english: so-so; passable; fairly okay; a little bit capable [colloquial]
[粵] 還可以、尚可、過得去；略懂
[粵] 略帶古怪、不怎麼樣（戲謔或反語語境）

examples.yue: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食得得哋啦，唔算好食但勝在平。
examples.eng: The food at this restaurant is fairly okay; it is not super delicious but it is affordable.

examples.yue: 我啲英文得得哋咋，日常溝通仲勉強應付到。
examples.eng: My English is just passable, barely enough for daily communication.

examples.yue: 條友平時份人得得哋㗎，你唔好咁認真聽佢講嘢。
examples.eng: That guy is a bit weird sometimes, do not take what he says too seriously.
